question: Under what minimal condition is that entity said to be called the supreme Śiva?
premises: An entity is referred to by the demonstrative he.
The condition given is merely the leaving of the body.
Under that condition, he is called the supreme Śiva.
inference: Upon merely leaving the body, that entity is called the supreme Śiva.
uncertainties: Scope of mātra as merely or only remains open
plain_english: Upon merely leaving the body, he is called the supreme Śiva.
